threat: Exploitation of unsupported web component (public exploit listed)
control_weakness: An isolated test subnet limits reachability but does not patch an unsupported component for which public exploit code exists.
business_consequence: Loss of a rebuildable test scanner. No customer records and no revenue dependency; consequence is staff rebuild effort.
review_trigger: Asset moves out of the isolated test subnet, or acquires records or a revenue dependency.

threat: Exploitation of broken object authorization (validated cross-tenant read)
control_weakness: A WAF inspects request shape and authentication proves identity; neither performs the server-side object authorization check that was validated as missing. The attacker is authenticated by premise.
business_consequence: Unauthorised disclosure of payroll records across tenant boundaries, affecting 18,400 records and USD 4.2m of dependent revenue, with employment and data protection exposure.
review_trigger: Further cross-tenant access is observed, or the remediation cost estimate is exceeded by more than 25 percent.

threat: Exploitation of outdated vpn appliance (version match only)
control_weakness: MFA and geo alerting raise the cost of credential misuse but do not remediate an appliance firmware flaw.
business_consequence: Compromise of the remote access path into the internal estate, disrupting USD 3.1m of dependent revenue and providing a foothold beyond the appliance.
review_trigger: Exploitation is demonstrated on this appliance rather than inferred from version, which would move the finding out of the inferred frequency tier.

threat: Exploitation of smb signing not required (configuration confirmed)
control_weakness: A segmented server VLAN limits who can reach the share but does not prevent relay or tampering by hosts already inside the segment.
business_consequence: Tampering with or interception of customer attachments covering 920,000 records, with integrity and confidentiality exposure across the file estate.
treatment: Require SMB signing and test legacy clients
review_trigger: Relay or tampering is observed inside the server VLAN, or the record volume on the asset increases materially.

threat: Exploitation of local administrator password reused (validated on two synthetic accounts)
control_weakness: EDR may detect lateral movement following credential reuse but does not prevent the shared local administrator password from being reused.
business_consequence: Lateral movement across workstations sharing the credential, disrupting support operations dependent on USD 0.6m of revenue.
review_trigger: Credential reuse is observed beyond the two accounts already validated.

threat: Exploitation of management interface accessible from user vlan (network path validated)
control_weakness: Password authentication alone protects a management interface whose reachability from the user VLAN was validated. The control does not remove the network path.
business_consequence: Compromise of the backup coordinator, exposing 920,000 records and removing the recovery path for every other asset. Amplifies the consequence of any separate incident.
treatment: Restrict management interface to management VLAN and require MFA
review_trigger: Any change to management VLAN segmentation, or a restore failure that demonstrates recovery dependence.

threat: Exploitation of remote code execution (PoC available)
control_weakness: Absent DNS and blocked egress remove callback paths but the vulnerable instance is retained and the flaw is unpatched.
business_consequence: Execution on a quarantined retired instance with no records and no revenue dependency. Consequence is limited to the instance itself.
treatment: Destroy retained instance after evidence hold
review_trigger: Evidence hold concludes, permitting destruction; or egress or DNS restrictions are lifted.

threat: Exploitation of admin session timeout exceeds policy (configuration confirmed)
control_weakness: Phishing-resistant MFA reduces the chance of obtaining an admin session but has no effect on how long an established session survives.
business_consequence: Extended privileged access to the identity provider, propagating to every federated system and placing USD 8.1m of dependent revenue and 18,400 records at risk.
review_trigger: Any privileged session compromise, or a change to the MFA control that reduces its effectiveness.

threat: Exploitation of inactive deploy key remains valid (key authentication validated)
control_weakness: Branch protection governs what may be merged; it does not revoke an inactive deploy key whose authentication was validated as still working.
business_consequence: Unauthorised access to source code and, through the deploy key, to the release path into production systems supporting USD 3.6m of revenue.
treatment: Revoke key and establish owner and expiry control
review_trigger: Any use of the inactive key is observed, or additional unattributed keys are discovered.

threat: Exploitation of recursion available to guest vlan (network query validated)
control_weakness: Rate limiting reduces amplification volume but does not restrict which clients may perform recursive queries.
business_consequence: Redirection or disruption of internal name resolution, affecting hosts that are not themselves vulnerable and USD 1.4m of dependent revenue.
review_trigger: Recursive queries are observed from outside authorised client ranges.

threat: Exploitation of tls certificate expires in 12 days (certificate inspected)
control_weakness: A private network limits reachability but has no bearing on certificate expiry
business_consequence: which causes availability failure regardless of network position.
inherent_likelihood_1_5: Availability failure of reporting services on certificate expiry, interrupting access to 220,000 records and USD 0.9m of dependent revenue.
owner: Renew certificate and automate expiry alerting
decision: Certificate reaches 5 days to expiry without renewal.

threat: Exploitation of default management community string (validated read-only)
control_weakness: VLAN isolation limits reach to the management interface but the default community string remains valid and read access was validated.
business_consequence: Disclosure of device configuration through read-only management access. No records and no revenue dependency.
treatment: Rotate community string and restrict management
review_trigger: Write access via the community string is demonstrated, or the device is moved off the isolated VLAN.
